course.title: Engineering Economy
course.department: Department of Industrial Engineering and Management

content.value: Two sites are currently under consideration for a bridge over a big river. The north site requires a suspension bridge. The south site has a much shorter span, allowing for a truss bridge, but it would require new road construction. The suspension bridge will cost \$600 million with annual inspection and maintenance cost of \$250,000. In addition, the concrete deck would have to be resurfaced every 11 years at a cost of \$ 1,000,000. The truss bridge and approach roads are expected to cost \$250 million and have annual maintenance costs of \$200,000 for first 5 years and \$205,000 in the subsequent year. This bridge would have to be painted every 3 years at a cost of \$400,000. In addition, the bridge would have to be sandblasted every 10 years at a cost of \$1,900,000. The cost of purchasing right-of-way is expected to be \$20 million for the suspension bridge and \$150 million for the truss bridge. Compare the alternatives on the bans of their capitalized cost if the interest rate is 6 % per year.

_source_title: B.Sc. Engineering 3rd Year 1st Term Regular Examination, 2016
